title: kissed earthy monsoon ukrainian dried white beans tagine
description: a hearty, earthy, pillowy dish inspired by the monsoon season in ukraine, featuring dried white beans cooked in a tagine, suitable for ayurvedic and sattvic diets

ingredients.name: dried white beans
ingredients.notes: such as ghee or coconut oil

instructions: heat the oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
add the carrots and cook for 2 minutes.
add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and turmeric, and cook for 1 minute.
add the dried white beans, water, and vegetable broth, and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
season with salt and black pepper to taste.
stir in the lemon juice and parsley.
serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
